## Part 1

```{r}

input <- "bgvyzdsv"
#input <- "abcdef"

five_zeroes_start <- function(i, n) {
  paste0(i, n) |>
    charToRaw() |>
    tools::md5sum(bytes = _) |>
    str_detect("^00000", negate = TRUE)
}

five_zeroes_start(input, 609043)

counter <- 0

while (five_zeroes_start(input, counter) && counter < 1e6) {
  if (counter %% 50000 == 0) {
    message(counter)
  }
  counter <- counter + 1
}
counter
```

5.2 seconds

254575

## Part 2

```{r}

input <- "bgvyzdsv"
#input <- "abcdef"

six_zeroes_start <- function(i, n) {
  paste0(i, n) |>
    charToRaw() |>
    tools::md5sum(bytes = _) |>
    str_detect("^000000", negate = TRUE)
}

counter <- 0

while (six_zeroes_start(input, counter) && counter < 10e6) {
  if (counter %% 100000 == 0) {
    message(counter)
  }
  counter <- counter + 1
}
counter
```
